finish_summary:
1) parse_coupon: Implementation rejects codes with leading/trailing spaces and case differences, contrary to spec.
2) Cart.remove_item: Does not remove item when quantity reaches zero (only when <0), violating spec.
3) Cart.total: shipping_fee uses subtotal before coupon instead of after discount, contradicting specification.
4) Constants FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD and SHIPPING_BASE are referenced but undefined in the provided module, leading to NameError during import. This also violates spec that these should exist.
